description:
Step 1 of a bring-your-own-agent fact-check. Fetches one of the
        authenticated user's documents (ownership enforced) plus the exact
        disclosure and method your agent MUST follow. Requires a personal
        Storskarvia API key as a Bearer token.

        After this, call ground_claim(claim) once per checkable claim you
        extract from `text`, then submit_findings(...) to store results.
name: prepare_factcheck
